run_binary_search: run a recursive binary search on a sorted array to find the index of a target value
test_binary_search: test the binary search function against multiple parameter sets and compare results
create_binary_search: create a recursive binary search function that returns the index of a target or -1
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold binary search function to use an iterative approach instead of recursion
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which performs recursive binary search on an array between left and right bounds
